title: A difference
description: A difference that a comparison of two versions found in one unit, in version 1 of the API. A later minor change can add members, so a client ignores the members it does not know.

unitKind.description: The kind of its unit. For example, article.

num.description: The label of its unit as printed. For example, (a). Empty if it has none.

parent.description: The eId of the unit that it is in. Null for an outermost unit.

section.description: The eId of the unit with a title that it is in, as the outline nests them.

markers.description: The amendment markers of the later text: which acts gave the unit its form, and how.

earlierMarkers.description: The amendment markers of the earlier text.

amendments.description: The amendments that Cellar records at the unit between the two versions.

before.description: The plain text of the unit before the change.

after.description: The plain text of the unit after the change.

changes.description: The runs of words, in order. The text before is the runs that are not insert. The text after is the runs that are not delete. A line feed ends each paragraph, and each number and heading of a unit in the unit, except the last.

shown.description: The unit, marked. In its HTML, inserted words are in ins and deleted words are in del. Its plain text is the text after the change.

act.description: The CELEX number of the amending act.

in.description: The eId of the unit that the act gave its form as a whole. Null for a marker of the unit itself.

amendment.description: An amendment that Cellar records at a unit.

act.description: The CELEX number of the amending act.

cited.description: How the Official Journal cites the amending act. For example, 2019/103.

location.description: Where it acts, as Cellar codes it.

role.description: What it did. For example, replacement.

from.description: The day from which it applies, as Cellar records it. Null if Cellar has none.

change.description: A run of words, and what the comparison found of it.

op.description: equal: the run is in both versions. insert: only in the later version. delete: only in the earlier version.
